issue.title: `obj.await` should not throw error.

repository.name: js
repository.description: Monorepo for the JS language tools.

issue.body:
From https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/5564
On v3.1.1.

In `obj.await` case, `await` should not throw a syntax error because this `await` is `IdentifierName` (a reserved word is allowed).
Acorn has succeeded to parse it.
I guess this error caused by [this line](https://github.com/eslint/espree/blob/master/espree.js#L115).

``` js
"use strict";

const espree = require("espree");
const ast = espree.parse(
    `obj.await`,
    {
        ecmaVersion: 6,
        sourceType: "module"
    }
);

console.log(JSON.stringify(ast, null, 4));
```
